## [1.3.2](https://github.com/MrCool-888/mrcool-patches/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2) (2026-11-08)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **OpenBubbles:** add classic reply and swipe options ([fca22f5](https://github.com/MrCool-888/mrcool-patches/commit/fca22f5fce5497da1580019ebdd27e05aae9c688))
* **SmartLauncher:** keep Buds widget layout in sync ([90df9b8](https://github.com/MrCool-888/mrcool-patches/commit/90df9b82099c43cf678ecbf309918f6b1c051cf7))

patches.name: Classic reply menu
patches.description: Adds inline replies and a separate swipe direction switch in OpenBubbles Settings → Morphe patches.

patches.name: Ready for messages notification control
patches.description: Adds a setting to hide or show the background connection notification independently of the Wear bridge.

patches.name: Wear companion bridge
patches.description: Embeds the Wear companion in OpenBubbles and includes a background notification control; no separate phone app is needed.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.

patches.name: Fix Galaxy Buds3 Pro widget
patches.description: Fixes widget configuration on Samsung One UI 8.5 and keeps the widget layout in sync with its size.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Pro features that normally require a purchase.
